key_facts: Substernal chest pain lasting less than 5 minutes
Chest pain occurs with running more than 2 miles
Hypertension controlled with lisinopril and hydrochlorothiazide
No family history of premature coronary artery disease
No chest pain during exercise treadmill test
ST depressions during recovery phase of exercise treadmill test

raw.rationale: The patient's symptoms and test results, including the CCTA showing 3-vessel involvement, PET-MPI showing severe ischemia, and coronary angiogram confirming these findings, best support this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Chronic stable angina
rejected.why: While the patient's symptoms could suggest chronic stable angina, the extent of 3-vessel involvement and severe ischemia seen on imaging tests indicates a more severe condition.

rejected.label: Ischemic Heart Disease
rejected.why: Ischemic Heart Disease is a broader term that encompasses the champion diagnosis; the specific findings in this case point more directly to three-vessel obstructive coronary artery disease.
